[IRET.7.10.1] A `then ... within` sequence compiles to a
linear left-associative chain of join nodes plus test CEs
(RLOW.5.6). A two-step sequence `A then B within T`
produces:

```
alpha(A) → beta_join_1 → alpha(B) → beta_join_2(test: ts_B - ts_A < T) → terminal
```

Each additional `then C within T2` appends one more join
node; the `within` constraint becomes a test CE on the
immediately preceding event pair (RLOW.5.6.3). The chain
is linear, not a DAG.

idris.name: Rlow_4_2_1__chain
idris.note: One linear chain of beta nodes per rule, in LHS order; `then` chains are the same shape.
